thread:
lee: Heads-up: planning to remove SDK pin on hosted-api (sdk 3.4.0 -> 4.0.0) during 02:00-03:00 UTC change window. This unpin enables the new auth header v2 and faster multiplexing. Need ops + release notes. Any major objections?
ana: can we gate on clients migrating? lots of internal teams still on 3.x and rely on old header name.
rachel: rollback criteria? also need a note for the mobile SDK team about TLS downgrade check.
lee: rollback: deploybot will reapply sdk_pin=3.4.0 if 5xx_rate>1% sustained for 10m or 401s spike >2x baseline. We'll do canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with manual approval before the final bump.
deploybot: schedule created. gating= "mobile-team/compat==ok" and "sdk/pr/4201==merged". Will annotate each stage with metrics.
tyler: FYI telemetry: ap-south saw an auth spike last week after minor header rename test. recommend a preflight night smoke with SDK-integration tests.
lee: agree. Added a 20m preflight at 01:40 UTC that runs the integration tests against a shadow route. If any test fails, abort.
rachel: release notes: include migration snippet `Authorization: Bearer <token>` -> `X-Auth-V2: Bearer <token>` and call out mobile workaround. I'll draft a one-paragraph blurb.
infra-bot: load-shedding policy attached: if p95>2s AND cpu>85% across canary nodes, hold and notify.
lee: update: PR 4201 merged at 01:12 UTC :white_check_mark:. Mobile team sign-off received at 01:25 UTC. All gates clear. Deploybot proceed at 02:00.
deploybot: Canary started 02:02 UTC -> 5% clients routed to SDK 4.0. Metrics: 5xx_rate flat, 401s +12% but within threshold. Advancing to 25%.
tyler: seeing a small steady climb in 401s from legacy clients in eu-central. Not critical yet but suggest holding before 100%.
lee: hold before final bump. Let's keep at 25% for 15m and watch error breakdown.
deploybot: holding at 25% per request.
rachel: quick check: mobile SDK 1.9.0 still sending old auth header in some batched requests; mobile team pushing a hotfix. If that hotfix doesn't land, we may see continued 401 noise.
tyler: new mobile hotfix scheduled in 18m. recommend we wait.
lee: decision: abort final bump to 100% for tonight. Keep 25% canary; schedule full rollout after mobile hotfix verified. I'll update release notes: "canary held due to client 401s; no rollback performed; gating for full rollout added."
deploybot: Affirmed. No rollback executed. Canary remains at 25%.
infra-bot: monitoring: alert threshold lowered for this run; paging enabled for oncall on elevated 401s.
rachel: I've added the migration snippet and a short troubleshooting section in #release-notes. Include `curl` examples and note the fallback header mapping.
lee: thanks all. New plan: full rollout next night window only after mobile hotfix and an additional 30m smoke. Tagging @tyler for verification. Closing this thread; followups in #release-notes and the mobile channel.
